notes.title: New BETA build available!
notes.content:
Hello Tamers!

Today a new BETA build for NEXOMON is available on Steam! We know our community have been waiting for an update and now that our translators are finally free we managed to translate Nexomon to more languages as promised!

On behalf of the NEXOMON team, we apologize for the delay and we are grateful to all of you for your patience. 

In this update, we added the following new content just for you:

+ A NEW WIND LEGENDARY Nexomon is now available to be caught! Luhava can appear anywhere at random, but the chances are low unless you have captured plenty of Nexomon. The more unique Nexomon you own, the higher will be the apparition rate of Luhava.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/38e45f8c19d207df72368b592175e86a5d8f1c41.png[/img]

+ We added a new pet for you to unlock in your profile: Luhava!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/abbb6c5ff9f9022ba32c09c9c059ca40cb8f644d.png[/img]

+ We decided to redesign some of the common monsters and also gave them a small upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36192113/8ef9e9b8b5b2b43d42a0f9997bf45b651f7f7c24.png[/img]

Other changes:

+ French localization added.
+ German localization added.
+ Spanish (LATAM) localization added.
+ Chinese (simplified) localization added.
+ Grinding: enemies will now yield 50% more EXP.
+ Status Effects: they can now last from 1 to 3 turns, as opposed to just one turn
+ Dialogues are much faster now.
+ Various common monsters were graphically updated.
+ EXP Share and EXP Multiplier items will further boost the EXP gained by 30%.
+ Fixed an issue that caused Wardens to be marked as "defeated" despite having lost to them.
+ Remove the action button from appearing in front of Ivan's gym buddies, since they don't trigger dialogues.

To play the BETA release, right click on STEAM > Properties > Beta > Select Branch. 
We hope you keep enjoying the game!

Thank you!

- The Nexomon Team

notes.title: New update available now.
notes.content:
Hi!

This patch includes:

+ [CHANGE] The default volume level for music and effects is now 50%. All save files prior to this update will be automatically set to 50%.

+ [FEATURE] A tooltip will now appear on top-left of screen with the name, description, power and accuracy of the selected skill during battle.

+ [FEATURE] You can now sort your storage by Name, Level, Rarity and Element.

+ [BUG] Fixed Steam Achievements in-game popup. Achievements were being unlocked only after closing the game, but now you should see the notification immediately.

+ [BUG] We may have fixed an issue causing the volleyball minigame to be exceedingly sped up on some devices.

+ [BUG] Some NPCs reference NexoBoxes from the mobile version of the game.

notes.title: Update with settings and other fixes available now.
notes.content:
This update includes:

Features:
- Settings button in the Nexopad.
- Sound and music options.
- Option to toggle text sound on/off.
- Option to toggle full screen/windowed mode.
- Option to quit game.

Bugs:
- Slow downs caused by particles fixed (like the Ventra scene and snow areas).
- Catch rate rebalanced.
- Normalized sound effects.

More coming soon!

Thanks for helping us make Nexomon a better experience :) !
